lead.title: OpenAI pushes ads deeper into the AI conversation
lead.deck: OpenAI is testing Sponsored Agents in ChatGPT, alongside prompt-based ad creation and new AI creative tools. For marketers, the ad journey is moving closer to a conversational, agent-led experience.

note: Editorial filter: only developments with practical relevance to digital marketing, performance marketing, SEO, analytics, ecommerce, CRO, creative production or automation.

stories.title: OpenAI tests Sponsored Agents for ChatGPT Ads
stories.summary: OpenAI is testing sponsored agents that let people start a conversation with a business-sponsored agent after clicking an ad. It is also adding prompt-based ad creation and new AI creative capabilities in Ads Manager.

stories.title: Meta launches an enterprise AI platform around agents
stories.summary: Meta says its new enterprise platform will bring Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code to businesses and developers. This expands the potential role of AI agents from consumer assistance into business operations and marketing workflows.

stories.title: Meta expands Muse into small-business workflows
stories.summary: Muse for Small Business can connect tools such as Shopify, Canva, Klaviyo and Slack plus business accounts, with approval controls before anything publishes, sends or spends. This makes cross-tool AI workflow automation more accessible to smaller teams.

stories.title: Google expands AI Max briefing and reporting
stories.summary: Google is expanding AI Brief to additional languages and introducing reporting that connects search terms, creative assets and landing pages in one AI Max journey view. The change is aimed at improving visibility into AI-driven Search performance.

stories.title: Google highlights Gemini Omni for on-brand video ads
stories.summary: Google Ads is highlighting Gemini Omni for creating on-brand video assets faster. The development points toward tighter integration between generative creative production and campaign asset workflows.

stories.title: Meta connects Muse with business tools and accounts
stories.summary: Meta's small-business Muse rollout can connect multiple work and marketing tools plus Facebook and Instagram business accounts. The practical implication is a move toward AI agents that can coordinate marketing operations rather than only generate copy.

stories.title: Microsoft AI Max for Search reaches all advertisers
stories.summary: Microsoft says AI Max combines search-term matching, text customization and final URL expansion for Search campaigns. It is designed to capture more conversational intent while giving advertisers reporting and controls to guide the automation.

stories.title: Microsoft Advertising MCP connects ad data to AI assistants
stories.summary: Microsoft says its Advertising MCP server can connect live advertising data to AI assistants such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT and Claude for reporting, audits and keyword research. This creates a practical path toward agentic account-management workflows while retaining human review.

stories.title: Google documents new structured-data changes
stories.summary: Google Search Central's September documentation updates include a new creator property for VideoObject and expanded documentation for local business queries in aggregator and supplier units. These changes matter for teams maintaining structured data and search eligibility.

stories.title: Google AI Max reporting moves toward journey visibility
stories.summary: The new AI Max reporting view is designed to connect the search term that triggered an ad, the creative asset shown and the landing page reached. For performance teams, this could make AI-driven Search easier to audit at the query-to-landing-page level.

stories.title: Google Ads pushes Gemini Omni into video asset creation
stories.summary: Google's September 28 Ads announcement highlights Gemini Omni for creating on-brand video ads. The opportunity is faster creative iteration, provided brand controls and human review remain part of the workflow.

stories.title: OpenAI adds AI creative tools to Ads Manager
stories.summary: OpenAI says its Ads Manager is gaining new AI creative tools alongside prompt-based ad creation in ChatGPT Work. This brings creative generation closer to campaign-building workflows.

stories.title: Meta turns its AI stack into business tooling
stories.summary: Meta is packaging agents, APIs and coding capabilities for businesses and developers through its new enterprise platform. Agencies could use these capabilities as building blocks for operational automations, subject to access, permissions and review controls.

stories.title: Salesforce reports agentic search becoming a larger shopping entry point
stories.summary: Salesforce says agentic search as the first step in the purchase journey grew 200% year over year in its latest commerce research. It also reports that traffic referred from AI chats grew substantially faster than overall traffic, reinforcing the need to measure AI-originated discovery.
